release_notes:
Share photos and videos, plus an important image fix.

• Share images and videos to Memosly from any app — Memosly now shows up in the share sheet for pictures and video, not just text. Share several at once (up to 9); they upload straight into a new memo.
• Files over 32 MB are refused up front with a clear message instead of failing mid-upload, matching the Memos server's own default upload limit.
• Fixed: images added in the editor never showed up on Memos server v0.25/v0.26. They uploaded fine but were linked to no memo, leaving the file on the server and invisible everywhere. This affected every image added through the editor and has been broken since v1.1.1 — if you have images that went missing, re-add them and they will stick.
• Fixed: sharing several files at once could silently drop some of them.
• Fixed: a share that arrived while the editor was already open could resurface later and attach itself to an unrelated memo.
release_notes_zh:
支持分享照片和视频，并修复一个重要的图片问题。

• 可以从任意 App 把图片和视频分享到 Memosly —— 分享面板里不再只认文字，图片和视频也能选到 Memosly。支持一次分享多个（最多 9 个），直接上传进新备忘。
• 超过 32 MB 的文件会提前拒绝并给出明确提示，而不是传到一半失败，这个上限与 Memos 服务端默认的上传限制一致。
• 修复：在 Memos 服务端 v0.25/v0.26 上，编辑器里添加的图片从来不显示。图片其实上传成功了，但没有关联到任何备忘，文件躺在服务器上却哪里都看不到。这影响所有通过编辑器添加的图片（不只是分享的），自 v1.1.1 起一直存在 —— 如果你有图片「消失」了，重新添加一次即可正常保留。
• 修复：一次分享多个文件时，可能会静默丢掉其中几个。
• 修复：编辑器已经打开时收到的分享，可能在之后重新出现并附加到不相干的备忘上。
